RagShortTexts: Success, tribute and protection sustain Ermanaric’s standing.
Punishment without protection encourages alternative partners.

Variants.Content: Experience, tribute and deterrence create royal standing. Without protection, punishment encourages alternative partners; delivered aid weighs more than nominal submission.

Success, tribute and protection sustain Ermanaric’s standing. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Punishment without protection encourages alternative partners.
